Government Engineering College of Uttar Pradesh, affiliated
to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow
(U.P.), approved by AICTE. The institute offers B. Tech, M.
Tech and MCA degrees as per AICTE norms.
